name: frost-field
title: Frost Field
description: Calm light glass for wellness products. Frosted white panels and floating chrome over a fixed pastel aurora field (lavender, sky, mint, peach); Manrope display over Inter body; a high-fill glass recipe (0.55 regular, 0.72 under body text, 0.35 chrome only) with solid reduced-transparency and near-opaque no-backdrop fallbacks; pill controls, 14px/20px radii, airy one-idea-per-card density.
author: uiforagents
notes: One-shot PASS 2026-10-12, instructor profile page (the spec's named program-detail type is a documented prompt-pack recipe, so per the group one-shot rule the nearest undocumented page type was used; recorded here and in the README row). Fill discipline is the identity: 0.55 regular glass for empty panels, 0.72 strong fill mandatory under body text, 0.35 chrome only for hero panels and docks; body text on chrome sits on a strong-fill plate. The aurora field is fixed on the body; the drift loop is flavor and prefers-reduced-motion stills it. Accessibility floors ship as tokens: prefers-reduced-transparency swaps to solid #fbfbfd surfaces (geometry holds), @supports not (backdrop-filter) raises fills to 0.95 white, forced-colors flattens to plain borders. Accent is the contrast-tuned step of the soft violet family (#6a5ae0, 5.1:1 on white); the pastel viz four (violet/sky/mint/rose) are thin strokes and small fills, never large fills. The sixth block is activity-log (list semantics) because the brief's density cap bans tables and ledgers.
